Game Overview

Cheddar Chomper is a arcade title where guide your hungry mouse through cheese-filled mazes, dodging prowling cats in this fast-paced adventure. Plan your moves wisely to outsmart feline foes and collect as much cheese as possible. With adorable graphics and endless fun, Cheddar Chomper offers a delightful challenge for all ages.
